title: The ceiling and profile deny rules anchor at each session's own checkout, so a worktree session can write the main checkout's files by absolute path
goal: .claude/settings.json's deny rules refuse an agent's Edit or Write of _tools/tests_ceiling.json, a _decisions.csv and _private/host.json in any checkout of the clone, the main checkout's files written by absolute path from a linked worktree included (Claude Code's absolute-path rule form, checked against the live permissions docs), as ST-7s3sp7sl's goal and the operator's deny-rules answer say; maintaining.md states the form and what deny rules cannot cover (Bash redirection)

run: import json,sys;d=json.load(open('.claude/settings.json'))['permissions']['deny'];w=[x for x in d if x.startswith(('Edit(//','Write(//'))];need=['tests_ceiling.json','host.json','_decisions.csv'];m=[n for n in need if not any(n in x for x in w)];print('files with no absolute-path deny rule:',m);sys.exit(1 if m else 0)

repro_reason: the defect is the deny rules' path form; whether Claude Code refuses an Edit runs only inside a live agent session, so the repro reads the rule forms the fix must add
